scripts.dev: concurrently --raw --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000" "pnpm --filter web dev"
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.install:all: pnpm install && cd apps/api && uv sync
scripts.test: pnpm -r test && cd apps/api && uv run pytest
scripts.lint: pnpm -r lint && cd apps/api && uv run ruff check .
scripts.format: pnpm -r format && cd apps/api && uv run ruff format .
